map.印刷看样台、打样台照度均匀性检测：在台面网格布点测 cd/m²，确认无明暗梯度影: Illuminance uniformity check for a printing proofing or sample table: place measuring points on a grid over the surface to measure cd/m² and confirm that no bright-dark gradient affects colour judgement.
map.坎德拉每平方米，是亮度的国际标准单位（也称尼特 nit）。灯箱、屏幕标称亮度都用: Candela per square metre, the SI unit of luminance (also called nit). It is used for the rated brightness of light boxes and screens. Measurement requires a photometric probe calibrated in a dark environment, otherwise ambient light raises the reading and understates the true uniformity.
map.常用「最小亮度/最大亮度」或「1-(最大-最小)/平均值」。前者直观但受极端值影: Commonly use "minimum brightness / maximum brightness" or "1 − (max − min) / average". The former is intuitive but strongly affected by extreme values, while the latter is more sensitive to overall dispersion. This tool also gives the standard deviation so you can tell whether the whole surface changes gradually or individual points drop sharply, since a sharp drop at a single point usually means one LED or a local light guide defect.
map.灯箱、发光字、广告牌出厂前多点测量亮度，评估整面发光是否均匀，避免局部暗斑影响展: Before a light box, illuminated letter, or billboard leaves the factory, measure the brightness at multiple points to assess whether the whole surface lights evenly, avoiding dark patches that hurt the display effect.

map.面板、屏幕亮度一致性抽检：同一批次多台设备测多点亮度，用统计量判断是否超出允许离: Spot check the brightness consistency of panels and screens: measure multi-point brightness on several units of the same batch and use statistics to judge whether it exceeds the allowed dispersion range.
map.：数据量 n=8，总和 2809，平均值 351.13，中位数 353，最小值: : Count n=8, sum 2809, mean 351.13, median 353, minimum 320, maximum 372, range 52, variance 234.11, standard deviation 15.30. Uniformity commonly uses one of two definitions: min/max = 320/372 ≈ 0.86 (the closer to 1, the more uniform), or dispersion 1−(max−min)/mean = 1−52/351.13 ≈ 0.852; the standard deviation of 15.30 cd/m² reflects how much each point varies around the mean. If the contract requires uniformity of at least 0.9, then 0.86 does not meet it and the light source layout must be adjusted.
